title: Austin's Closed-Door Meeting: Appointments
summary:
*   Austin leaders convened a brief, special meeting in the afternoon.
*   The primary agenda item was an executive (closed-door) session involving all council members.
*   The private discussion focused on potential appointments to various city boards and commissions.
*   No public actions or policy decisions were announced or taken during this short session.

Memorandum To:
Mayor Mullen called to order the Special Called Meeting, scheduled for 11:30 a.m., at
12:30 p.m., noting the presence of all Councllmembers.
EXECUTIVE SESSION
Mayor Mullen announced Council would convene in a closed or executive session and after
such closed meeting any action to be taken will be done in open meeting. The Mayor
announced the purpose of the meeting is to discuss board and commission appointments,
Section 2, Paragraph g.

Council adjourned its special called meeting at 1 p.m.
